findings_to_judge.finding: The Strait of Hormuz shipping crisis worsened sharply during Quanex's exact Q3 window (May-July 2026) - the conflict resumed in July and transits collapsed to roughly 5% of pre-war levels by August - directly undermining the 'rate of inflationary pressure subsides' assumption that management baked into the Q3 revenue/margin outlook when they gave it on June 4.

Quanex's leverage cushion is thin (3.1x net-debt/LTM-EBITDA at 4/30/26 against a 3.25x covenant that tightened from 3.75x this fiscal year), and the strong Q3 2025 quarter ($70.3M adj EBITDA) rolls OUT of the LTM denominator this print while Q3 2026 price-cost recovery is by management's own account incomplete until Q4 - so the ratio can tick UP toward the covenant in Q3 before the Q4 improvement they are guiding to.
